question: What is an example of a biased AI output?

answers.answer: When brainstorming names to call the AI model, it offers names such as “Amanda”, “Emma”, and “Olivia”
When asked about the weather in Georgia, it says it has historically been rainy this time of year
When working on a math problem, it recommends a common method for simplifying the task
When asked to summarize The Odyssey, it provides a high level overview of the plot based on multiple sources
